description: Minimal capability for the main window. The dsh web UI uses no Tauri IPC except the injected drag-region script (startDragging), so only core defaults plus that one permission are granted. Downloads are handled Rust-side via on_download and uploads use the standard file input, so fs/dialog/shell/global-shortcut permissions were removed: they granted the remote page (http://127.0.0.1:3080) unused filesystem/shell reach that only expanded the attack surface.
